challenges.says: The third criterion cites scope.decision-14, which only says filters and search are carried in full; it cannot carry that the disabled product list 'looks unusable and readable' (and the wording is unclear to a product owner).
The fourth criterion cites scope.decision-14 for status icons from the icon set and a focused, empty ID box; that decision says nothing of icons or focus, so the criterion has no support.
The Escape criterion cites scope.decision-14, which cannot carry closing as cancelled; no rule is cited for it either.

The fourth criterion cites only title or description and drops the comment condition of businessrule-51916167191556979448 (user or computer comment), and the open question points to a 'Decision 6' that is not named and, as integrations.decision-6, covers storing comments, not a ban on comment search.
The Escape criterion cites scope.decision-14, which cannot carry closing as cancelled.
The third criterion cites scope.decision-14 for a title column filling the list width and smooth drawing; that decision says nothing about either.
The third criterion says 'lower-numbered' area, a code detail a product owner cannot follow; it should say Computer beats User, and both beats neither, in plain words.
